title: Salty Seagull | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Prime Seacrest Location | Resort Pool & Beach Tram | Between Rosemary & Alys - Salty Seagull by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Salty Seagull by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Resort Address: 7 Endless Summer Way Details: Southern charm meets relaxed coastal living at the Salty Seagull, a beautifully designed cottage tucked within the heart of Seacrest Beach. Perfectly positioned between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this coveted 30A location places you steps from some of the area’s best dining, shopping, and entertainment. Inside, the home features stylish new furnishings and thoughtfully designed spaces that make it easy to unwind after a day in the sun. Guests also enjoy access to Seacrest’s spectacular 12,000-square-foot resort-style pool, one of the largest along Scenic Highway 30A, along with deeded beach access just moments away. During the summer season, the community tram provides effortless transportation to the beach, where soft white sand meets the sparkling emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Whether you’re spending the day by the pool, exploring the charming streets of Alys and Rosemary Beach by bike, or relaxing at the shore, the Salty Seagull offers the perfect home base for an unforgettable 30A getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Prime Seacrest Beach location between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach - Access to the 12,000 sq. ft. resort-style community pool - Deeded beach access with seasonal tram service - Newly furnished coastal interiors - Easy bike ride to shops, restaurants, and entertainment along 30A - Parking Spaces: 3 - Dining Accommodations: Seating for 12 Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths First Floor: -Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath -Guest Room 2: Bunk Room (Twin/Twin) with Shared Bath -Sleeper Sofa -Kitchen / Living / Dining /Large Screened Porch -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Guest Room 3: Two Queen Beds with Private Bath -Guest Room 4: King Bed with Private Bath Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
